steps.title: Ada can't approve her own company's KYB
nor open a bank account before Bridge approves it
Bridge approves it
an approved KYB can't be approved again
nor turned down afterwards
Ada reads it back as approved
Bo sets up a company of his own
Bo starts its KYB
Bo can't turn down his own KYB either
Bridge turns Bo's down, with its reason
a turned-down KYB can't then be approved
and opens no bank account
Ada's approval is untouched by Bo's refusal
Bo can't open an account on Ada's company
Ada opens a US dollar account and gets where to send deposits
Bo can't read it
the company has one open account by a name
she opens a euro account under another name
it reads back as the second account, not the first
Bo can't start KYB for a company he doesn't run
Ada starts her company's KYB and gets Bridge's form and terms
Bo can't read Ada's KYB
a company has one KYB, so a second start is refused
reading it back shows what she typed, still started, with a form and terms that differ
Ada can't give a second company of hers the same name
nor the same abbreviation
Bo may use both for his own company, because her names don't bind him
Ada sets up a second company under other names, which she runs too
her second company reads back as she typed it, not as her first
Bo still can't read Ada's
Ada's company is untouched and still hers
Ada sets up a company and runs it
Bo can't read a company he doesn't run
reading it back shows what she typed, with her as its owner
Bo sets up a company of his own, which he runs
Ada can't read Bo's company
Bo reads his back, exactly as he typed it
